title: 9 משחקים וספרים שיעזרו להם לתרגל מוטוריקה עדינה

stage.need: Using the fingers and hands with control, for children from about 3 to 5: CDC lists stringing large beads or macaroni and using a fork at 3, holding a crayon between fingers and thumb and unbuttoning some buttons at 4, buttoning some buttons at 5, and tips such as an activity box of paper and crayons, blocks to build with, paint, child scissors and glue. Games with small pieces give the fingers a reason to move, books about drawing and making give the ideas. The week of the clock change (Israel, Sunday 25 October 2026) is also a week for quiet evening play: HealthyChildren lists reading a book that is not on a screen among relaxing evening activities.
stage.age_caveat: Ages are approximate: CDC milestones are what most children (75% or more) do by an age, not a deadline. Some 4 year olds still hold a pencil in a fist and some 3 year olds already button; the frame says בסביבות and the caption says ויש ילדים שצריכים עוד זמן. Several products start at 2 (the younger end) and several books are labelled for kindergarten (5 to 6), the older end.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Strings items together, like large beads or macaroni / Uses a fork / Give your child an "activity box" with paper, crayons, and coloring books. Color and draw lines and shapes with your child.
dev_sources.supports: 3 year movement milestones (strings large beads or macaroni, uses a fork) and the tip to keep an activity box with paper and crayons. Page last reviewed May 16, 2026. Read today through a page fetch (the CDC site blocks plain curl); the lists are quoted as returned, joined with ' / '. Milestones are what most children do by an age, not a deadline.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 4 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Catches a large ball most of the time / Serves herself food or pours water, with adult supervision / Unbuttons some buttons / Holds crayon or pencil between fingers and thumb (not a fist) / Give your child toys or things that encourage his imagination, such as dress-up clothes, pots and pans to pretend cook, or blocks to build with. / Try to make time for active play each day.
dev_sources.supports: 4 year movement milestones (catches a large ball, pours with supervision, unbuttons some buttons, holds a crayon between fingers and thumb) plus tips: blocks to build with and daily active play. Page last reviewed May 16, 2026. Read today through a page fetch; lists joined with ' / '.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 5 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Buttons some buttons / Hops on one foot / Keep a box of crayons, paper, paint, child scissors, and glue for creative play. / Teach her how to pump her legs back and forth on a swing / Try to make time for active play each day.
dev_sources.supports: 5 year movement milestones (buttons some buttons, hops on one foot) plus tips: a box of crayons, paper, paint, child scissors and glue, learning to pump a swing, daily active play. Page last reviewed May 16, 2026. Read today through a page fetch; lists joined with ' / '.

dev_sources.title: Daylight Saving Time: Don't Lose Sleep Over It
dev_sources.publisher: HealthyChildren.org, American Academy of Pediatrics Section on Integrative Medicine (page last updated 31 Oct 2025)
dev_sources.quote: Getting enough exercise during the day can help kids sleep better, too. Just avoid too much physical activity close to bedtime, which can make it hard to unwind. Choose quiet activities like stretching or yoga later in the day. ... Relaxing activities in the evenings support a healthy sleep cycle. Examples include a warm bath with Epsom salts, reading a book that's not on a screen, meditation, soft music or writing in a journal.
dev_sources.supports: Daytime exercise can help kids sleep, quiet activities later in the day, and relaxing evening activities such as reading a book that is not on a screen support a healthy sleep cycle. The page is about the US time changes and is used here for the week Israel's clocks go back (Sunday 25 October 2026, Maariv). It is not about any product.
